author: RqdPlays
body: my IGN is Rqdplays. i used to hack on your servers in its original form. i was one of the first players on avicus. it was my first server and i used to play legit on it. i started hacking and the first server was Avicus. it has been almost a year that i have not hacked yet. after being banned from all these servers i realized how stupid i was and i was going to lose them all eventually. so i i wanted to appeal to all the servers i care about. please take this appeal into consideration
